title: {enemy:skirmisher}
text:
三把{item:knife}，一下接一下。每下不重，可一直不停。

{item:tower_shield}每下减 {item_stat:tower_shield:block}，正好把它的刀磨成钝的；{item:plate_cuirass}的护甲会被它磨光，然后你会一直掉血。

texts.en:
Three blades, each a {item:knife}, one strike after another. No single hit is heavy, but they never stop.

The {item:tower_shield} takes {item_stat:tower_shield:block} off every hit, just enough to blunt them. The Armor on the {item:plate_cuirass} gets worn away, and after that you just keep bleeding.
